answer: A concrete defense is bond-and-slash identity staking. Each agent locks a refundable deposit to join; every epoch it must emit one signed pulse of real work, recorded crystal-clear on the ledger. Reputation accrues like a pearl: slow, non-transferable, and worthless the moment a bond is slashed for collusion. A sybil army therefore needs one full bond per fake node, so attacker cost rises linearly with identities while honest rewards stay split thin, leaving the attack net-negative.
